working_on.task: Tender Pick Span height suggestion persistence
working_on.notes: Đã sửa lỗi chiều cao bị reset về 3000mm. Release v0.2.77.

recent_changes.description: Fix: Stabilize Tender Pick Span height persistence by introducing global state variable _lastPickedSpanHeightMm
Fixed total width = 135 units across all 3 sheets (min=max to disable dynamic sizing)

decisions_made.decision: Use static global field _lastPickedSpanHeightMm in TenderBomDialog to persist height
decisions_made.reason: Prevents resetting to 3000mm when new rows are initialized or new picking loops start, allowing spans to inherit the previous span's height seamlessly.

decisions_made.decision: Set total table width = 135 units across all 3 Excel sheets
decisions_made.reason: 135 units = 243mm, fits 93% of A4 Landscape printable area (261mm). Ensures all sheets have identical right-edge alignment.

errors_encountered.error: Height suggestion resets to 3000mm during Pick Span
errors_encountered.root_cause: Hardcoded 3000mm fallbacks in PrepareTargetRowForPick and PickSpanFromCad loop initialization overridden previous user input.
errors_encountered.resolution: Replaced hardcoded 3000 with a globally persistent _lastPickedSpanHeightMm variable.

context_checkpoints.summary: Fixed Tender Pick Span height persistence. Height is now saved globally via _lastPickedSpanHeightMm. Version bumped to v0.2.77.
